notes.title: 2.1 Update content
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fix the bug that there is no flashlight in Qin Hong's hand after turning on the flashlight when he walks
[*] Fix the bug that the screen becomes dark after entering the principal's office
[*] Fix the problem that the ghost flickers back to the corridor after the small wooden horse trigger appears in the school building
[*] Fix the problem that the coordinates of Qin Hong's character when running are biased upwards
[/list]

notes.title: November 29th Update Log
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Redesigned the environment brightness and reset the filter color
[*] Modified the trigger condition of the doll, you can take the doll directly from 2 weeks onwards
[*] Modified the mini-map of the large maze in the back playground to show the locations of ghosts, switches, doors, etc.
[*] Modified the misspelled words "meditation" and "noon" in the ending
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes on Nov. 21
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug of hiding in the locker on the second floor of the dormitory will be invisible
[*] Modified the way of entering and exiting all stairways, before the problem of going back to the previous floor due to pressing too fast
[*] Fixed a text bug in the letter to "Tan Ping", where Principal Hu was wrongly written as Principal Chen
[/list]

notes.title: November 20 update log.
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Adjusted the brightness of the beginning in the teaching building
[*] Adjusted the problem of too green in the dormitory 301 filter
[*] Fixed the bug that the flashlight could not be used when Qin Hong just entered the backyard
[*] Fixed some wrong words and sentences in the text
[*] Fixed some time bugs in the text
[*] Fixed the bug that some columns in the back playground did not rise up after stepping on the switch
[*] Added a closet next to the locker in the dormitory corridor to hide, the description in the previous letter was hide not hide, which brought ambiguity to the players.
[/list]
